evidence: Baker and engineer John Robie are the credited producers of 'Planet Rock' (1982) for Tommy Boy Records.

later.artist: Afrika Bambaataa and the Soulsonic Force
later.title: Planet Rock

trackPair.whatToListenFor: Both records share Baker's production fingerprints: hard, dry electro drums and a preference for interpolated melodic hooks over sampled ones.

explanation.age7: Arthur Baker was the producer who helped Afrika Bambaataa build "Planet Rock" in the studio.
explanation.age13: Baker and Bambaataa worked together at Tommy Boy Records to build "Planet Rock" out of Kraftwerk parts and a drum machine.
explanation.adult: This edge separates the producer's specific contribution from the machine's (see e-808-planetrock) and the sampled material's (see e-kraftwerk-planetrock): three distinct, individually documented inputs into one record.
